text:
alex_chen: heads-up — right after the v2.3 rollout we started getting a batch of function-call failures on the /generate endpoint. Customers get a 400 with \"schema_validation_failed\" and the tool chosen is often wrong (web_search vs vector_search).

maria_g: which customer / policy? any pattern on model version or routing?

alex_chen: all orgs hitting the new default:v2.3 model variant, region us-west. Looks like when prompt includes a long context (>3k tokens) the model returns a tool name that our router maps to legacy web_search. The tool args are then truncated and the JSON validator rejects. Sample payload and error below.

alex_chen: ```
Request: {
  "model": "gpt-redwood-v2.3",
  "input": "<long user context>...",
  "function_call": {"name": "vector_search", "arguments": {"query": "...", "k": 10}}
}
Response (from model): {
  "name": "web_search",
  "arguments": "{\"query\":\"...\", \"k\": 10, \"extra_field\": \"...\"}"
}
Error: schema_validation_failed — arguments truncated or stringified, failed to parse JSON
```

eng_tariq: thanks, this looks like a model-side tool selection drift — v2.3's tool-calling framing changed slightly and the canonical tool names overlap with our routing aliases. The model sometimes emits a legacy alias and also serializes the args as a string.

sre_josh: we are also seeing a spike in tail latency for those requests (p90 up ~250ms). Not sure if retries + parsing errors cause retries.

pm_elaine: escalated by 2 paying customers this morning. They want either a rollback or a hotfix. Can we get a repro and a mitigation plan?

alex_chen: repro steps attached — minimal prompt that triggers it included below. Quick mitigation I tried: transformation rule in router to coerce alias names and parse stringified args. It reduces errors by ~60% in staging but feels brittle.

alex_chen: ```
Minimal repro: POST /v1/generate
headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>
body: {"model":"gpt-redwood-v2.3","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"search: find docs about X. context: <3.5k tokens>"}],"functions":[{"name":"vector_search","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string"},"k":{"type":"integer"}}}}],"function_call":{"name":"auto"}}
Expected: model calls vector_search with JSON args
Observed: model returns name: \"web_search\" and arguments: \"{...}\" (string) or truncated JSON
```

eng_tariq: temporary router patch LGTM for immediate relief. Long-term we should pin the model variant with a function-calling compatibility shim or ask model team for a quick prompt-finetune to output canonical names and JSON args.

sre_josh: +1 on pinning for the affected orgs. Rolling back the global default to v2.2 would stop new regressions but we'd lose v2.3 perf wins. We should offer customers an opt-out toggle too.

maria_g: do we have telemetry to count how many orgs hit this? Also need to know if billing got impacted (failed calls that still charged).

support_bot: incident created: INC-2024-3492 — function-call-schema-failures-after-v2.3-rollout. Tags: priority-high, billing-risk, routing. Assigned: eng_tariq, alex_chen, sre_josh.

pm_elaine: proposed immediate action list:
- deploy router alias-coercion patch to us-west (eng_tariq)
- enable org-level pin to v2.2 for affected customers and notify (support + pm)
- gather precise telemetry and billing impact (maria_g)
- open model-team ticket for v2.3 function-calling regression (alex_chen)

eng_tariq: I'll push the router patch to canary now and monitor errors. If failure rate doesn't drop within 15m we revert rollout and set default back to v2.2.

alex_chen: uploading logs to /shared/incidents/INC-2024-3492/logs and adding a list of affected org_ids. Will DM for org-level rollbacks.

maria_g: starting a quick query to compute failed-call counts and chargeable requests in the last 6h. Will post numbers in this thread shortly.

sre_josh: watch for retry storms — add rate-limit guard if we see spikes. Also check downstream tool services for malformed payloads.

eng_tariq: patch deployed to canary. initial error rate down ~58% in canary traffic. moving to partial rollout to us-west.

pm_elaine: nice — keep me posted. Support will prepare proactive outreach templates for affected customers.

support_bot: update INC-2024-3492: router-patch applied to us-west partial rollout. Error-rate decreased in canary. Next action: monitor 2h then decide global rollback vs targeted fixes.

alex_chen: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a postmortem draft after we close the incident.```
